stories.title: Germany blames Russia for Leipzig airport drone sabotage as hybrid attacks widen
stories.reason: The explosives-laden drone found near a Ukrainian plane follows separate suspected sabotage at Germany's power grid and a defense manufacturer, prompting Berlin to shutter a Russian consulate and push new EU sanctions.

stories.title: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade as US influence wanes in the Mideast
stories.reason: Xi's three-day visit, including AI and investment agreements with Cairo, shows Beijing moving to expand regional influence while Washington remains consumed by the Iran war.

stories.title: DOJ says states must report undocumented immigrants to DHS or risk losing federal funding
stories.reason: The sweeping revision extends reporting obligations to entire state governments and ties compliance to TANF and SSI dollars, setting up likely legal challenges from Democrat-led states.

stories.title: South Korea unveils $919 billion plan to build 18.4 gigawatts of AI data centers by 2035
stories.reason: SK Group, GS Group and Naver have already pledged $356 billion for the first phase, a national-scale bet that would multiply South Korea's data-center capacity roughly sevenfold.

stories.title: Nvidia officially confirms $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face
stories.reason: The deal, Nvidia's second-largest ever, moves from reported rumor to confirmed terms -- $11.9 billion to shareholders plus $1 billion in retention equity -- as it seeks to extend its dominance into open-source AI software.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber to auto-patch software vulnerabilities
stories.reason: Restricted to vetted defenders through Google's new Fairwind Program, the model generated correct vulnerability patches at 2.6 times the rate of larger competing models in Chrome Security team testing.

stories.title: Chevron pledges $7 billion to Venezuela as US oil companies finalize new deals
stories.reason: The investment, aimed at nearly doubling Chevron's Venezuelan output, follows Washington's deal for majority control of the country's oil reserves and underscores how quickly firms are moving to capitalize on it.

stories.title: Stocks rise and Treasury yields hit highest since 2023 as AI shares rally
stories.reason: The Dow and S&P 500 clawed back part of the week's losses even as the 10-year Treasury yield touched its highest level since November 2023, a sign markets are looking past the Iran war for now.
